newsitem.title: USA: Amphenol begins tender for senior notes.
newsitem.headline: Amphenol begins tender for senior notes.

text.p: Amphenol Corp said Tuesday that it has begun a tender offer for its outstanding 12-3/4 percent senior subordinated notes due 2002.
It said it is also soliciting consents to eliminate substantially all restrictive covenants related to the notes.

The tender offer price is equal to the present value on the payment date of $1,048 per note, determined on the basis of a yield to the earliest redemption date equal to the sum of the applicable reference U.S. Treasury yield on May 8, plus 75 basis points, less a consent payment of $20.00 per $1,000 principal amount of 12 3/4 percent senior subordinated notes for which a valid consent is received.
